name: Project schedule APIs (Dynamics 365 Project Operations)
short_description: The Project schedule APIs in Dynamics 365 Project Operations perform create, update and delete operations on scheduling entities such as projects, tasks and resource assignments through the Project Scheduling Service, typically batched in operation sets; they are used, for example, for bulk project migrations.

evidence.quote: this is where we need to look at how we can leverage something known as the schedule API in the tool.
